attacks.name: Sword Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Steel Rush
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Counter-Strike
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, roll four dice. Deal 1 |!damage| to the attacker for each |!critical| and each |!wild| rolled.

superPowers.name: Master Swordsman
superPowers.body: When it is the target of a |!physical| attack or targets a character with a |!physical| attack, this character may use this superpower. If the enemy character is within |!range| 2, this character may reroll any number of its attack or defense dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Tactical Insight
superPowers.body: While this character or another allied character within |!range| 2 is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may use this superpower. That allied character may reroll 1 die in their roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
